description: Start the device signup flow. Returns a user_code and verification_url for a human to approve in the SendGuard dashboard, and a device_code to pass to poll_signup. No API key needed.

monthly_spend_cap_usd.description: Optional monthly cap on purchases made with the key, in USD

scopes.description: Requested scopes: preflight:read, verify:create, billing:topup, billing:autorecharge. Defaults to preflight:read and verify:create

name: start_signup
title: Request an API key
